title: Film Reel Dreamweaver
description: A woman in a black coat with a film reel in her right hand walks along a glowing film strip path that crosses a cracked checkered floor. She emerges from an ornate gilded doorway framed by red curtains, with melting clocks, scattered film reels, and a cinematic theater visible in the surreal background.
prompt: A mysterious woman with dark hair wearing a long black coat and fur collar walks forward on a glowing film strip path laid across a cracked black and white checkered floor. She holds a film reel in her hand while colorful light trails flow from her body. She emerges from a highly ornate gilded doorway with red velvet curtains, cherubs, and a clock at the top. Melting clocks and scattered film reels lie on the floor. A dark theater with seats is visible in the background under dramatic cinematic lighting with purple and green hues.
